course_outcome: Analyze and implement binary search trees, heap structures, and graph traversal algorithms for problem solving.
Evaluate algorithmic time and space complexity using Big-O asymptotic notation and optimize sorting and searching routines.
Design relational schemas, apply normalization principles up to 3NF, and construct complex SQL queries with ACID guarantees.
Implement B-tree indexing, transaction management, concurrency control, and integrate relational databases with backend applications.
Apply object-oriented design principles (SOLID), inheritance, polymorphism, and standard design patterns to build modular software.
Collaborate using Git version control workflows, branching strategies, and write automated unit test suites for software verification.
Build responsive front-end user interfaces using semantic HTML5, modern CSS3 (Flexbox/Grid), and asynchronous JavaScript (ES6+).
Construct RESTful API web services with Node.js and Express, implementing routing, middleware authentication, and JSON data serialization.
Configure TCP/IP socket communication, HTTP/HTTPS client-server protocols, and analyze common web security vulnerabilities (CORS, CSRF, XSS).
Analyze process scheduling algorithms, multithreading concurrency, deadlocks, and virtual memory management in modern operating systems.
Perform data ingestion, cleaning, feature transformation, and exploratory data analysis using Python, NumPy, Pandas, and visualization libraries.
Train, evaluate, and tune supervised and unsupervised machine learning models including regression, decision trees, and clustering using Scikit-Learn.
Containerize multi-tier web applications using Docker and configure automated Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Deploy and manage scalable cloud services, configure reverse proxies (Nginx), manage environment variables, and configure cloud object storage.
